# Reel

> Track and discover movies and TV shows, build a personal watchlist, rate what you've watched, and see what's coming next.

Reel is a free web app for browsing trending and popular movies and TV
shows, saving titles to a personal watchlist, tracking watched episodes, and
viewing personal viewing stats.

## Pages

- [Discover](/): Trending and popular movies and TV shows, plus search.
- [Movies](/movies): Popular movies with sorting and search.
- [TV Shows](/shows): Popular TV series with sorting and search.
- [Upcoming](/upcoming): Upcoming releases and new episodes for the titles saved in your list.
- [My List](/watchlist): Your saved titles, watched status and ratings.
- [Stats](/stats): Personal viewing statistics.

## Optional

- [Sign in](/auth): Account access to sync your watchlist across devices.
